loreSeeds.title: Public Notice: Exile Option
loreSeeds.text: The council offers a clean record: stand and be thrown, or step and let the water judge. Exile keeps the ledger tidy; retrieval is unnecessary once the Stakes take.

loreSeeds.title: Crowd Voice: The Stakes
loreSeeds.text: The crowd doesn’t debate the verdict. It chants the landing: Stakes, Stakes. Water will strip him clean.

loreSeeds.title: Melden’s Caution
loreSeeds.text: He told Igzier: never call anything pure if you want it to stay that way. Timing is not mercy; it is the only chance.

loreSeeds.title: Weep Physics: Secondary Surge
loreSeeds.text: There is a second push in the Weep. Miss it and the cliff keeps you. Catch it and the sea gets its say.

loreSeeds.title: The Stakes
loreSeeds.text: Black basalt teeth break the surf in rings. The first row is the city’s sentence; the second is the sea’s.

loreSeeds.title: Whisper: Survivors
loreSeeds.text: They say three cleared the Weep and never returned to the Hall. The ledger calls that myth. The water does not.

loreSeeds.title: Bond-Sickness
loreSeeds.text: A caged Stryker above the terraces is a live wire in the wind. The bond-pull blurs edges and tugs the body off center.

loreSeeds.title: Ledger Logic: The Circle
loreSeeds.text: Quick leaves a body. Exile leaves a circle. When a reasonable time passes, the accounts balance.

loreSeeds.title: Raceways: The Fish Know
loreSeeds.text: Feeder fish roll belly-up in the raceways when the channels go off-key. Watch the fish; they know before we do.

loreSeeds.title: Rot in the Breath
loreSeeds.text: When the vents breathe wrong, the city smells like rot. Boil the water if you can. If you can’t, stillness buys time.

loreSeeds.title: Greenhouse Note
loreSeeds.text: The misters tick the leaves, but the water runs wrong. Three fish float near the surface, gills hammering. The city will call it an anomaly.

loreSeeds.title: Stillness Gate
loreSeeds.text: Ravel’s rule: timing is a gate. If the hands still shake, the cure binds the poison in place. Wait until the body quits arguing.

loreSeeds.title: Ravel: The Quiet Trade
loreSeeds.text: He says the forest doesn’t cure; it answers. You trade certainty for survival and call it wisdom.

loreSeeds.title: Bort’s Hope
loreSeeds.text: Three warped spans of lashed timber rise out of teal mist. Lanterns gutter amber in the wind; the shallows decide the year.

loreSeeds.title: Reedbed Ambush
loreSeeds.text: Eel-riders hide left in the reedbed. False pennants pull them shallow; spears wait below the cattail line.

loreSeeds.title: Goreline Wedge
loreSeeds.text: Seven triceratops form a wedge and do not charge to break. They charge to anchor. Push, hold, breathe.

loreSeeds.title: Quills Sunburst
loreSeeds.text: Stegosaur handlers space the Quills like a moving hedge. When they turn, the tail-spikes bloom into a threshing sunburst.

loreSeeds.title: Thunderguard
loreSeeds.text: Three mammoths drag a log raft studded with stakes. Sinew lines turn the undercurrent into a net.

loreSeeds.title: The River Decides
loreSeeds.text: When the tide turns hard, the flats shift sideways. That hour is why the bridge holds.

loreSeeds.title: Bank Right
loreSeeds.text: Stryker stoops out of cloud like a flung spear. Signal: bank right, no repeat.

loreSeeds.title: Iron-Mouth
loreSeeds.text: A broad-skulled plesiosaur rides the shallows with a handler in bone rings. When it rises, the water humps like a living hill.

loreSeeds.title: Smoke Curtain
loreSeeds.text: Pitch-pots burst on the bridge and turn the head into a silhouette theater. In that curtain, hesitation wins more than steel.

loreSeeds.title: Doctrine of Equilibrium
loreSeeds.text: Sky City calls itself the keeper of the cycle. A passing is paired to a birth; a reassignment to a return. It is administrative theater that pretends balance.

loreSeeds.title: Threads for the Cycle
loreSeeds.text: A black thread for a passing. A white thread for a naming. Midwives and mourners cross on purpose and call it the city’s mercy.

loreSeeds.title: The Three Chairs
loreSeeds.text: Three chairs: the Minister of Selection, the Recorder of Measures, and the Prefect of Quiet-Men. Procedure sits where light falls fullest.

loreSeeds.title: Plaza Exchange
loreSeeds.text: Two lines meet and part: a black cloth for a passing, a white swaddle for a naming. They nod and keep walking. The city takes notes and calls it policy.

loreSeeds.title: Karys: The Wrong Door
loreSeeds.text: Don’t let them choose your ending. If a door must close, make sure it’s the wrong one.

loreSeeds.title: Giver of Light
loreSeeds.text: The Giver never takes. Keep a small light at dawn; palms east in thanks.

loreSeeds.title: Honest Seam
loreSeeds.text: The brief, stable lane between hostile currents. Ride it, don’t trust it.

loreSeeds.title: Wind Stairs
loreSeeds.text: Layered lifts and circular updrafts along cliffs. Flyers climb the stairs.

loreSeeds.title: Telitales
loreSeeds.text: Two narrow blushcloth ribbons on the prow. If they snap straight up or reverse, drop to the seam.

loreSeeds.title: Wing Tilt Signal
loreSeeds.text: Two quick wing tilts mean bad air ahead. Drop to the seam.

loreSeeds.title: Avogadro Scale
loreSeeds.text: 0°A is fresh water freezing; 100°A is boiling. Spore-fog risk rises above 22°A after storms.

loreSeeds.title: Spore-Fog
loreSeeds.text: Smells like wet pottery. Close your mouth and stay low.

loreSeeds.title: Night-Lash
loreSeeds.text: Barbed micro-hooks that leave a persistent night-scar.

loreSeeds.title: Unledgered Pact
loreSeeds.text: Whisper-oath: “No one belongs to a ledger.” Two knuckles tapped over the sternum.

loreSeeds.title: Null-Set
loreSeeds.text: The city’s tidy erasure mark. Names deleted from ledgers.

loreSeeds.title: Translation Tablets
loreSeeds.text: Stone and shell matrices encoding pitch into script. Dangerous to own.

loreSeeds.title: Star-Lattice
loreSeeds.text: A brass-bone instrument for bearings under canopy, aligned to the Meridian.

loreSeeds.title: Eyrie Charter
loreSeeds.text: Eyries are neutral waystations that imprint, feed, rest, and route homing raptors between peoples of Tethys, regardless of faction.

loreSeeds.title: Eyrie Safe-Conduct
loreSeeds.text: Approach an Eyrie unarmed and safe-conduct is granted within the marked bounds. No levy or seizure applies under Eyrie seal.

loreSeeds.title: Reed-Bone Tubes
loreSeeds.text: Messages travel in reed-bone tubes, resin-sealed and horn-stamped with the Eyrie scar. Orchid pigment marks the route and day.

loreSeeds.title: Eyrie Prohibitions
loreSeeds.text: It is forbidden to conscript eyries for war, weaponize payloads, tamper with seals, or employ tones within the bounds except in extremis by Silurian order.

loreSeeds.title: Cycle Slip Notice
loreSeeds.text: Cycles slipped in the east precinct. Reassignments will correct the imbalance without spectacle.

loreSeeds.title: Quiet Conclusion
loreSeeds.text: A vial will be offered in the tool room. Mercy is procedural if accepted. If refused, the water will balance the record.

loreSeeds.title: Door Opens, Door Closes
loreSeeds.text: A door closes; a door opens. It’s not policy. It’s how people survive the day.

loreSeeds.title: Eradicationists
loreSeeds.text: Quiet removals without trial. The Silent Hunts leave clean numbers.

loreSeeds.title: Matsu
loreSeeds.text: A vertical unit based on the Matsu tree. Common bearings reference the Meridian line.

loreSeeds.title: Drift Turn
loreSeeds.text: Bow right, hips left, weight forward. Ignore the clear lane; stay with the seam.

loreSeeds.title: Sulfidic Archipelago
loreSeeds.text: Aptian–Albian shallow basins formed a sulfur-driven food web: toxic to most aerobes, but explosively productive for adapted lineages.

loreSeeds.title: Photic Zone Euxinia
loreSeeds.text: Hydrogen sulfide rose into the lighted zone, creating a lethal curtain for most life and a niche for sulfur bacteria.

loreSeeds.title: Shallow Vent Hybrid
loreSeeds.text: Shallow volcanic vents created hybrid systems where chemotrophs and phototrophs co-occurred, feeding a split food web.

loreSeeds.title: Microbial Mat Engine
loreSeeds.text: Sulfide-oxidizing mats covered the seafloor where bioturbation failed; this was the base fuel of the sulfur web.

loreSeeds.title: Zooplankton Bridge
loreSeeds.text: When phytoplankton crashed under sulfide, zooplankton shifted to grazing bacterial mats and vent detritus.

loreSeeds.title: Kuphus Reefs
loreSeeds.text: Giant shipworm-bivalves formed tubeworm-like reefs in sulfidic muds, anchoring a benthic guild that fed on sulfur symbionts.

loreSeeds.title: Mudflat Scavengers
loreSeeds.text: Necrocarcinid crabs patrolled mangrove mudflats, scavenging Frenelopsis litter and cracking smaller tube shells.

loreSeeds.title: Shell Crushers
loreSeeds.text: Crushing predators targeted heavy-shelled clams and exposed tube mouths; the food web favored armored prey and durophagous hunters.

loreSeeds.title: Tide Hunters
loreSeeds.text: Large semi-aquatic predators hunted fish at the margins and pried soft bodies from tube reefs when the tide slackened.

loreSeeds.title: Anoxic Shift
loreSeeds.text: During anoxic pulses, the plankton web collapses and chemosynthetic guilds expand; survival concentrates in sulfur refugia.

loreSeeds.title: Ironwood Analog
loreSeeds.text: Ironwood maps to Araucarian megaforests of the Wealden Group and Patagonian fossil forests—dense, fire‑adapted conifers with resinous, decay‑resistant wood.

loreSeeds.title: Gargantua Analog
loreSeeds.text: Gargantua aligns with the Kohistan–Ladakh intra‑oceanic arc: steep volcanic islands, silicic domes, and collapse‑driven pyroclastic flows.

loreSeeds.title: Rookery Analog
loreSeeds.text: The Rookery matches Apulia–Hațeg carbonate platforms: shallow shelves ideal for pterosaur nesting and reef‑edge hunting.

loreSeeds.title: Hypercane Risk
loreSeeds.text: Sea‑surface heat in the Tethys supports hypercane‑scale storms; the margin becomes untrustworthy when pressure climbs.

loreSeeds.title: Sky City Lineage
loreSeeds.text: Sky City lineages adapt to canopy life: elongated forearms, tendon‑locking grips, and enlarged vestibular canals for balance on high, swaying boughs.

loreSeeds.title: Canopy Echolocation
loreSeeds.text: Dense canopy and crepuscular pressure select for echolocation: tongue‑click sonar, vaulted palates, and fixed vocal‑motor precision.

loreSeeds.title: Thal Lineage
loreSeeds.text: Thals evolve for arc heights: EPAS1‑like hypoxia tolerance, barrel chests, and enlarged nasal cavities to survive thin volcanic air.

loreSeeds.title: Ash Breath
loreSeeds.text: Silicic dome collapse produces ash‑choked air that scars lungs over time; masks are survival tech, not ritual.

loreSeeds.title: Chemical Arms Race
loreSeeds.text: Aptian–Albian forests were chemical battlegrounds; plants and fungi escalated toxins and antidotes under heavy herbivore pressure.

loreSeeds.title: Ergot Progenitor
loreSeeds.text: Palaeoclaviceps parasiticus infected early grasses by 110–97 Ma. Alkaloids were potent and dangerous, but could stop hemorrhage when processed.

loreSeeds.title: Ash‑Lye Processing
loreSeeds.text: Wood‑ash alkaline hydrolysis can tame ergot toxicity—fire‑dust water turns a killer into a hemostat.

loreSeeds.title: Stone‑Shelf Polypores
loreSeeds.text: Ancient polypores (Ganoderma lineage) provided bitter triterpenes and beta‑glucans; decoctions supported immune resilience.

loreSeeds.title: Ambrosia Galleries
loreSeeds.text: Beetle‑farmed ambrosia fungi produced antibacterial mats; harvested as topical wound paste and emergency nutrient.

loreSeeds.title: Visionary Pathways
loreSeeds.text: Psilocybin gene clusters likely predate the modern genus; visionary compounds exist, but lineages are unstable and risky.

loreSeeds.title: Mangroves of the Mesozoic
loreSeeds.text: Cheirolepidiaceae conifers formed dense, salt‑tolerant mangrove analogs in intertidal mudflats. Classopollis pollen marks warm, saline coasts; thick cuticles and sunken stomata made the understory a xeromorphic shield and resource base.

organismAnalogs.note: Resinous, decay‑resistant megaforests; fire‑adapted bark and dense wood.
Mangrove‑like conifers tolerant of salinity; dense intertidal thickets.
Proxy for warm, saline coastal environments; thick cuticles and sunken stomata indicate xeromorphs.
Stratovolcano chain with silicic domes and collapse hazards.
Shallow shelves favoring nesting rookeries and reef‑edge hunting.
Ergot alkaloid lineage on early grasses; potent hemostasis if processed.
Triterpenes and beta‑glucans; immune modulation and anti‑inflammation.
Antibacterial mats cultivated by beetles; topical wound paste.
